zh-CN.title: 旅行手册
zh-CN.goal: 把行程、选择与实际出行信息整理成手机可用的手册。

optionalInputs.question: 去哪里，有哪些想去或不想去的地点？
时间、天数与抵离安排是否确定？
几个人同行，有没有节奏、行动或饮食需求？
预算和住宿、交通偏好是什么？
是否已有预订或必须保留的安排？

qualityChecks: 手机上按天快速定位，展示步行与换乘余量；地图无网络时仍有文字地址。
票价、开放时间和政策需来源与查询日期，无法核实时标为待确认。
人数或日期缺失仍可给候选路线，不编造预订、身份资料和精确实时报价。
zh-CN.missingInformationPolicy: 所有问题均可跳过；使用已有资料，显式列出影响结果的假设，未知事实保留待确认。

en.title: Travel handbook
en.goal: Create a mobile-friendly handbook of plans, choices and practical travel details.

optionalInputs.question: Where are you going, and which places are included or excluded?
Are dates, duration and arrival/departure plans known?
How many people are traveling, with which pace, mobility or dietary needs?
What are the budget, accommodation and transport preferences?
Are there bookings or fixed activities to preserve?

qualityChecks: Enable quick day navigation on phones; leave travel buffers and offline-readable addresses.
Give sources and check dates for prices, hours and rules; flag unverified details.
Missing group size or dates need not block an outline; never invent bookings, identity details or live quotes.
en.missingInformationPolicy: All questions may be skipped. Use known material, state consequential assumptions, and leave unknown facts unresolved.
